description.html: The 70x50x50 cm terrarium has a floor of 3500 cm², half a meter of height and 175 liters. The back wall is a 3D styrofoam background, and ventilation is through a mesh vent. The 50 cm depth is generous for this length, so the background does not reduce the usable floor.

A kingsnake and a ball python have enough width for large hides and enough height for a branch. Growing Hermann's and Horsfield's tortoises do well with the wide floor and deep substrate. A blue-tongued skink uses the whole area. For a bearded dragon 70 cm of length is not enough once it is grown, so take it only for a young animal.

Longer models of the same width and height are the 80x50x50, 90x50x50 and 100x50x50. You choose the background relief and the film pattern when ordering. We ship by courier, and a terrarium of this size should be placed on a floor cabinet. If you need a length between these, we build it to order in 7 to 14 days.
